meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用 lark-cli 读取你的日历日程和未完成待办,汇总成指定日期的摘要,含日程表、待办清单、冲突提醒和空闲时段。
howto.when: 当你提到「今天有什么安排」「明天有什么会」等,或要生成早报、开工摘要时触发;仅支持 user 身份,需先授权 calendar 与 task。

say.text: 帮我看看今天有什么安排
say.note: 输出今日日程与未完成待办摘要

say.text: 明天有什么会?顺便列一下到期的待办
say.note: 查询明日日程并按截止时间排待办

say.text: 这周的日程和待办帮我整理成摘要
say.note: 汇总本周安排与未完成任务

howto.what_en: Claude calls lark-cli to read your calendar events and unfinished tasks, then writes a digest for a given date: schedule table, to-do list, conflict alerts, and free slots.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about today's, tomorrow's, or this week's plans, or ask for a standup/morning digest. User identity only; calendar and task auth required.

say_en.text: Show me what's on my schedule today
What meetings do I have tomorrow, plus tasks due
say_en.note: Tomorrow's agenda and tasks by due date

say_en.text: Summarize this week's schedule and to-dos
say_en.note: This week's plans and open tasks
